name: Forest Tide
source:
Forest Tide is an immersive Visual Novel, following the misadventures of Spirit and Ozzy. You play as Spirit, an aloof and dry magical being. You’ll meet Ozzy, the bubbly human who is mysteriously living in Forest Tide. Your budding friendship has many ups and downs, and along with the mysteries of Forest Tide, it's quite a handful. Passwords in gigantic old trees, glowing forest animals, Ozzy's deep dark past. This novel is all about friendship, finding family, and pushing your way through bad memories.

[From [url=https://willowprince.itch.io/forest-tide]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《森林之潮》是一部身临其境的视觉小说，讲述了斯皮里特和奥兹的不幸遭遇。你扮演的角色是精灵，一个冷漠而干燥的魔法存在。你会遇到奥兹，一个神秘地生活在森林潮汐中的活泼人类。你们刚萌芽的友谊经历了许多坎坷，再加上森林潮汐的神秘，它的难度相当大。巨大的古树、发光的森林动物、奥兹深深的黑暗过去中的密码。这部小说讲述的是友谊、寻找家人以及走出痛苦回忆的故事。

[来自[url=https://willowprince.itch.io/forest-tide]Itch.io[/url]]
